name: spryker-community/search-signals
description: Generates search-ranking's business-signal inputs from the shop's own traffic and data instead of requiring the adopter to source them: a GDPR-free SRP impression/click channel (Bayesian-shrunk CTR + query-volume weights for search-ranking-optimizer's term weighting), a project-overridable local-data transformer stack (e.g. stock, delivery time), and documentation for wiring an external batch source (e.g. S3) through Spryker's own Flysystem-backed DataImport.

suggest.spryker-community/search-ranking: search-signals emits the search_ranking_product_metric.csv contract this package consumes -- see README for the CSV wiring.
suggest.spryker-community/search-ranking-optimiz: search-signals' query-volume weights are exposed to the optimizer's term weighting via an optional Bridge -- see README. NOT YET BUILT.
suggest.spryker/stock: Required only if a project registers the shipped StockLevelMetricTransformerPlugin/DeliveryTimeMetricTransformerPlugin (Channel 2) -- see README, 'Channel 2'.
suggest.spryker/flysystem-aws3v3-file-system: Needed only for Channel 1 (S3 batch import) -- see README, 'Channel 1'.
suggest.spryker/flysystem: Needed only for Channel 1 (S3 batch import) -- see README, 'Channel 1'.

scripts-descriptions.check-floors: Verifies the declared dependency floors are real: resolves every constraint to its oldest allowed version (production deps only) and asserts each vendor symbol used in src/ actually exists there.
scripts-descriptions.rector: Applies Rector's configured rule sets (PHP floor upgrades + level-0 dead-code/code-quality) to src/, tests/, and tools/.
scripts-descriptions.rector-dry-run: Shows what Rector would change without writing anything.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at level 8. Must be run from a host shop (see README) -- needs the shop's generated Generated\Shared\Transfer\* classes and a freshly regenerated Ide/AutoCompletion stub, neither of which this package can produce standalone.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan-ci: Standalone CI variant of the phpstan check: generates just the Transfer classes this package needs and ignores the two categories of class that only exist inside a real host shop (Propel Orm\Zed\* models, the aggregated Ide\AutoCompletion stub).
scripts-descriptions.test-portable: Runs this package's own @group Portable Codeception tests standalone -- no demoshop, no live database, no search engine.
